landmarks.name: Lakeside
landmarks.description: Take the lift up beside the Puppet Testing Grounds Bell and activate the Lakeside Bell.

landmarks.name: Broken Puppet Pit Bottom
landmarks.description:
Defeating Dusk will grant players with the
Puppeteer's Bell
. After the cutscene, head to the corner of the arena to find another Bell: Broken Puppet Pit Bottom.

landmarks.name: [Crane-shaped] Puppet Testing Grounds
landmarks.description: After defeating the Musician Puppet boss, activate the crane-shaped Puppet Testing Grounds Bell.

landmarks.name: Beneath the Well
landmarks.description: Defeat the physical bodies of the three masters, descend to the bottom of the well, and activate the Beneath the Well Bell.

landmarks.name: Survivors' Courtyard
landmarks.description: From the Engine Giant Remains Bell, enter the room ahead and jump through the hole in the floor. Follow the path, grab the rope, and slide down. Enter Survivors' Courtyard to the east.

landmarks.name: Terraces
landmarks.description: Leave the river and head uphill to activate the Terraces Bell.

landmarks.name: Smuggler's Tunnel Entrance
landmarks.description: From the Smuggler's Treasure Cellar Bell, swing down on the rope to the lower level. Enter the cave and follow the tunnel to find the Bell.

landmarks.name: Smuggler's Treasure Cellar
landmarks.description: Follow the route in image 1 through the area where the enemies are fighting each other. Head right first and activate the Smuggler's Treasure Cellar Bell.

landmarks.name: [Crane-shaped] The Lady Grounds
landmarks.description: Appears after defeating Remains of Master Bi Yuan of the Tianxuan Sect.

landmarks.name: Statue Grounds Entrance
landmarks.description: Cross the Covered Bridge and continue up the steps to activate the Statue Grounds Entrance Bell.

landmarks.name: Black Serpent House
landmarks.description: From the shallows where the puppet controlling the red threads stands, head west to higher ground. Open the door and activate the Bell in the clearing ahead.

landmarks.name: Zhang's Hideout (Village of Lu)
landmarks.description: Look right from the Blazing Darkfire Charcoal location to find a secret passage. Follow it to the end to reach Zhang's Hideout (Village of Lu).

landmarks.name: Covered Bridge
landmarks.description:
Head west from Well of the Three Puppets and climb the steps to the end. Enter the house and deal with the weaver puppet, then turn left, climb the ladder, and open the door. Pick up the item near the room's exit.
Leave through the house and activate the Covered Bridge Bell. The bridge is blocked by red threads and cannot be crossed yet.

landmarks.name: Temple of Blue Fireflies
landmarks.description: A bridge is visible from the barred door. Follow the route in the image below to reach the Bell.

landmarks.name: Well of the Three Puppets
landmarks.description: Continue straight ahead from Zhuo Bi's boss arena to the well and activate the Bell beside it.

landmarks.name: Young Master Lan's Hideout
landmarks.description: Go under the bridge and head left as shown in the image below. Keep going straight to reach Young Master Lan's Hideout.

landmarks.name: Crossroads
landmarks.description: Take the path to the right of Jewel's house and head downhill to activate the Crossroads Bell.

landmarks.name: Broken Puppet Pit Entrance
landmarks.description: Collect all six of Firefly's Memory Flowers, dispel the mist, and enter the hidden area. There is a chest on high ground along the way; collect it before going down the slide. Activate the Broken Puppet Pit Entrance Bell.

landmarks.name: locked one-way gate
landmarks.description: Behind the boss arena. It must be opened from the underground well area.

landmarks.name: locked one-way gate
landmarks.description: From the Smuggler's Treasure Cellar Bell, head west to the rope. Swing down on it and open the barred door.

landmarks.name: locked one-way gate
landmarks.description: Start at the Covered Bridge Bell and follow the route in the image below to open the previously barred door.

landmarks.name: Tiger Cannon
landmarks.description:
Required Phantom Edge: Tiger Cannon
(Defeat Lei Dang at Mirage Estate to obtain it.)

landmarks.name: Flaming Mane
landmarks.description:
Required Phantom Edge:
Flaming Mane

(Not obtained on this map. Defeat the Lion Dance Grandmaster in Pangzhen to obtain it.)

landmarks.name: Dread Axe
landmarks.description:
In front of the wheat field.

Required Phantom Edge:
Dread Axe

landmarks.name: Bashpole
landmarks.description:
Required Phantom Edge:
Bashpole

(Not obtained on this map. Defeat Wan Jun, the Coppermaul in the Mandate Encampment region to obtain it.)

landmarks.name: scarecrow with the talisman
landmarks.description:
Location:
Head uphill from the Bell and follow the route in image 1 to the Terraces. Find the purple quest "Secrets at the Heart of the Lake (Village of Lu Scarecrow)" and defeat the boss "Acolyte Yanru" to receive the story item Yanru's Blazing Mask.

landmarks.name: Puppet Gate
landmarks.description:
How to unlock:

Defeat Mu Xiaokui and use Puppet No. 44's Eye to open it.

landmarks.name: Tunnel Cage
landmarks.description:
Location:

How to unlock:

landmarks.name: Village of Lu Cottage Cellar
landmarks.description:
Location:

In front of the Smuggler's Treasure Cellar. Climb down the ladder to see it.

How to unlock:

Village of Lu Cellar Key

landmarks.name: Mandate Encampment Outer Gate
landmarks.description:
How to unlock:

Mandate Encampment Outer Gate Key

(The Mandate Encampment is level 5 and cannot be reached yet. Return after obtaining the key in Pangzhen, level 4.)

landmarks.name: Slide
landmarks.description:
Location:
There is a slide beside Zhang's Hideout (Village of Lu) Bell that leads back to the farmland.

landmarks.name: Ladder to Kick Down
landmarks.description:
Location:
After reaching Survivors' Courtyard, head south to the cliff and kick down the ladder.

landmarks.name: [Powerful] Wild Oriole Sword
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Pick up the weapon Wild Oriole Sword on the dock.

Weapon assessment:

It consumes quite a lot of Sha-Chi and requires somewhat more forging materials, but its stats are very high, so it is recommended.

Its high Sha-Chi consumption means it is not an effortless option, but it delivers both performance and looks. You can choose between it and the dual blades in Pangzhen.

landmarks.name: Fiend Saws
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
If you have collected all five Young Mistress red ribbons, the boss Mu Xiaokui gains an additional final phase, summoning the Young Mistress's guard Jade Dancer into the battle. Defeat the boss to receive this weapon as an additional reward.

Weapon assessment:

Its Sha-Chi skills are costly, but its stats are very high. It is recommended as your main weapon for your first run through Pangzhen.

landmarks.name: Tianxuan Bronze Sword
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Defeat Remains of Master Bi Yuan of the Tianxuan Sect.

Weapon assessment:

You cannot perform perfect blocks with this weapon, and its attacks are very slow. Even though it can block automatically, using it is not recommended.

landmarks.name: Heartrend Pipa
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Defeat Yuzan, No. 3 Musician Puppet.

Weapon assessment:

A ranged weapon. Soul Tempering upgrades it into the Illusory Pipa, which can dispel the mist at Illusory Pipa interactions and control lesser enemies. It is worth trying after Soul Tempering.

landmarks.name: Puppeteer's Bell
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Dropped by Dusk, the Puppeteer.

Weapon assessment:

Another excellent tool for a summon-focused build. In my opinion, it is better than Kuye Temple Prayer Beads and is particularly suitable for fights against multiple bosses.

landmarks.name: Kuye Temple Prayer Beads
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Defeat Remains of Master Bi Hai of Kuye Temple.

Weapon assessment:

Here comes the summon build! Pair it with the accessory from the quest "A Puppet's Wooden Heart" that increases summon duration. It is especially effective against Dusk and the two guardians later on.

landmarks.name: Bastion
landmarks.description: Dropped by Zhuo Bi the Gatekeeper.

landmarks.name: Remnant Spark Cage
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

Pick it up behind the locked door to the Village of Lu Cottage Cellar.

Effect:

When a Phantom Edge follow-up move is triggered, there is a 33% chance to restore 1 Dark Source.

landmarks.name: Fine Thread
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

Complete the treasure collection in Village of Lu and obtain it through the quest "Quick Hand's Request".

Effect:

Damage and Sha-Chi depletion dealt by summons +50%.

landmarks.name: A Puppet's Wooden Heart
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

Obtained through the quest "A Puppet's Wooden Heart".

Effect:

Summon duration +25%.

landmarks.name: Agarwood Prayer Beads
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

When speaking to the monk, be sure to choose "I do not believe". Then hand over the prayer beads dropped earlier by the monk in the valley to receive the accessory Agarwood Prayer Beads and complete the Local Tale "Leave No One Alive".

Effect:

Your recovery time after a guard break -15%.

landmarks.name: Arrowward
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

After completing the Local Tale "Leave None Alive", give the Thief's Manual to the Wounded Thief to receive it.

Effect:

Ranged damage and Sha-Chi depletion suffered -20%.

landmarks.name: Livingwood Talisman
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

After opening the barred door, head south to the lower level. Open the chest inside the house to obtain the accessory Livingwood Talisman.

Effect:

Bleed and lifesteal work at 50% effectiveness against puppets, golden bodies, and phantasms.

landmarks.name: Mother's Talisman
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

Head west from Well of the Three Puppets and climb the steps to the end. Enter the house and complete the Local Tale "A Dream of Motherhood (Weaver Puppet)" to receive the accessory Mother's Talisman.

Effect:

Restores 10% of your health when your guard is broken.

landmarks.name: Jewel's Knot
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

In the golden chest behind Jewel.

Effect:

Health +15%.

landmarks.name: Forbidden Concoction
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

From the shallows where the puppet controlling the red threads stands, head west to higher ground. Open the door and climb the ladder to floor 2 to obtain the flask Forbidden Concoction.

Effect:

Phantom Edge damage +10% for 15 seconds; also restores 20% health.

Uses: 2

landmarks.name: Spirit-Returning Broth
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

Start at the Well Bell, climb the stairs, and continue straight until you see the Statue of the Lady of the Veil. Turn left into the house to find a ladder leading to the basement.

Climb down the ladder and pick it up by the puppet.

Effect:

Guard-break power +10% for 30 seconds; also restores 20% health.

Uses: 3

landmarks.name: Border Poems
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Past the Tiger Cannon obstacle.

Can be used as a Soul Tempering Material for Wolfjaw.

landmarks.name: Border Banner
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Use Bashpole to break through the stone wall. Can be used as a Soul Tempering Material for Bastion.

landmarks.name: Fist Fragment: Core
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Defeat Mu Xiaokui. This is a fragment of the Soul Tempering Material for the Iron Gauntlets.

landmarks.name: Black Serpent Venom Sac
landmarks.description: Collect all the corpses to obtain the Serpent's Memory, which is used as a Soul Tempering Material for White Serpent and Crimson Viper.

landmarks.name: Sturdy Bowstring
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Use Flaming Mane, enter the house, then open the chest in the second room on the right.

Can be used as a Soul Tempering Material for Feather Bow.

landmarks.name: Blackstone Fragment
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Continue from the Puppet Testing Grounds. At the fork, turn right first and defeat the enemies to remove the red threads. Obtain a Blackstone Fragment and the story item Small Tunnel Cage Key.

landmarks.name: Blackstone Fragment
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
In the chest on the riverbank in front of the boss arena.

landmarks.name: Blackstone Fragment
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Start in the farmland and use the Dread Axe to break the chain on the north side. Reach the river channel and defeat the enemies. There are many items to collect here, including behind the tree.

landmarks.name: Blackstone Fragment
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Open the chest in front of the boss arena.

landmarks.name: Sha-Chi Amber Fragment
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
At the Engine Giant Remains Bell, enter the house ahead and jump to the bottom through the gap indicated by the arrow.

Go outside and turn left, then use the rope circled in red to slide down to the courtyard below.

Drop from the roof and turn left. Follow the stairs into the higher house.

Head left from the house entrance to find a chest beneath the shed. Open it to obtain the third Sha-Chi Amber Fragment.

landmarks.name: Sha-Chi Amber Fragment
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Cross the Covered Bridge and follow the route in image 1 to the house to the east. Climb down the ladder and open the chest at the end of the path on the left.

landmarks.name: Sha-Chi Amber Fragment
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
In Mu Xiaokui's boss arena, open the chest beneath the tree to the left of the dock to obtain a Sha-Chi Amber Fragment.

Note that once you take the lift down, it breaks and you cannot return that way. Do not worry too much, though; you can come back from the lake surface area later.

landmarks.name: Sha-Chi Amber Fragment
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Meet the villager holding his wife beneath the bridge and search the river channel. There is a chest at its southern end. Kill Ping's puppet to make the Memory Flower "Villagers of Lu (Part 1)" appear on the ground.

Then return beneath the bridge and speak to the villager holding his wife to receive a Sha-Chi Amber Fragment.

landmarks.name: Wulin Fighters' Memory Flower - II. Live and Die Together
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
From Well of the Three Puppets, descend to the bottom of the well and pick up the Memory Flower "Wulin Fighters (Part 2)".

landmarks.name: Memory Flower of the Villagers of Lu - III. A Solitary Release
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Leave Survivors' Courtyard, turn left, and go down the steps. Pick up the Memory Flower "Villagers of Lu (Part 3)" at the cave entrance. There is a chest in the house beside it.

landmarks.name: Firefly's Memory Flower - IV. The Source of Calamity
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
From the Engine Giant Remains Bell, enter the room ahead and jump through the hole in the floor. Follow the path and pick up the Memory Flower "Firefly (Part 4)" for the purple quest "Secrets at the Heart of the Lake (Memory Flower 4)".

landmarks.name: Mandate Masters' Memory Flower - III. The Conspiracy
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Activate the Engine Giant Remains Bell. Enter the house and destroy the master's body, then pick up the Memory Flower "Mandate Masters (Part 3)".

landmarks.name: Memory Flower of the Villagers of Lu - II. Is That My Son?
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
From the boss arena, follow the river to its end and pick it up.

landmarks.name: Mandate Masters' Memory Flower - II. A Wish
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Appears after defeating Remains of Master Bi Hai of Kuye Temple. Pick it up in the boss arena.

landmarks.name: Wulin fighters' Memory Flower - I. Where Lies Hope?
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Enter the house to the left of the boss arena and pick it up in the room on the left.

landmarks.name: Mandate Masters' Memory Flower - I. The Righteous and Evil
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Appears after defeating the boss.

landmarks.name: Firefly's Memory Flower - V. No Word
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Cross the Covered Bridge and follow the route in image 1 to the house to the east. Climb down the ladder and find it at the end of the path on the left.

landmarks.name: Firefly's Memory Flower - III. The Herald
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
From the Covered Bridge Bell, follow the wooden walkway on the left to the wheat field. Pick it up in the small shrine at the back.

landmarks.name: Firefly's Memory Flower - VI. The Acolyte
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Enter the house beside the Bell to obtain the Memory Flower "Firefly (Part 6)" for the purple quest "Secrets at the Heart of the Lake (Memory Flower 6)".

landmarks.name: Memory Flower of the Villagers of Lu - I. Lovers' Reunion
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
A bridge is visible from the barred door. In the southern part of the river channel beneath it, you will meet a villager holding his wife. There are items to collect at the southern end of the channel. Kill Ping's puppet to make the Memory Flower "Villagers of Lu (Part 1)" appear on the ground.

Then return beneath the bridge and speak to the villager holding his wife to receive a Sha-Chi Amber Fragment.

landmarks.name: Firefly's Memory Flower - II. Phantom Art Illusionist's Settlement.
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
A bridge is visible from the barred door. Go to the river channel beneath it and follow the northern branch to its end to obtain the Memory Flower "Firefly (Part 2)" for the purple quest "Secrets at the Heart of the Lake (Memory Flower 2)".

landmarks.name: Firefly's Memory Flower - I. Heart of the Lake
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
On the left side of the boss arena.

landmarks.name: Memory Flower of Transcension Defyers - II. Parting Ways
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Pick up the Memory Flower "Transcension Defyers (Part 2)" beside the Mandate Encampment Outer Gate Bell.

landmarks.name: Memory Flower of the Villagers of Lu - IV. That is Not My Father
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Obtain the Memory Flower "Villagers of Lu (Part 4)" in the house beside the Bell.

landmarks.name: Puppet No. 44's Eye
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

Defeat the boss Mu Xiaokui.

Use:

Opens the Puppet Gate.

landmarks.name: Tunnel Cage Key
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

From the Puppet Testing Grounds Bell, turn right at the fork first and defeat the enemies to remove the red threads. Obtain a Blackstone Fragment and the story item Small Tunnel Cage Key.

Use:

Open the Tunnel Cage ahead and speak to the thief to obtain the Village of Lu Cellar Key.

landmarks.name: Village of Lu Cellar Key
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

From the Puppet Testing Grounds Bell, open the door to find two cells ahead. One contains a chest; in the other, a thief gives you the story item Village of Lu Cellar Key.

Use:

Village of Lu Cottage Cellar

landmarks.name: Yanru's Blazing Mask
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

Defeat the boss Acolyte Yanru to obtain the story item Yanru's Blazing Mask.

Use:

Quest item for "Secrets at the Heart of the Lake".

landmarks.name: Story Pipa Head
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

Defeat Dusk, the Puppeteer.

Use:

Quest item for "Illusory Pipa".

landmarks.name: Old Man Gen's Brass Key
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

After opening the route to Pangzhen beneath the well, remember to return to Old Man Gen and Young Master Lan and tell them that the passage to Pangzhen is open. Agree to help Old Man Gen to receive the story item Old Man Gen's Brass Key.

Use:

Unlocks the front door of Old Man Gen's home in Pangzhen.

landmarks.name: Cui's Red Ribbon
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

Speak to Xiaocui and accept the quest "Xiaocui" to receive it.

Use:

Quest item for "Xiaocui".

landmarks.name: Hunter's Dog Bell
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

Interact with the sleeping hunter with a large flower over his face.

Use:

Quest item for the Local Tale "Dahuang".

landmarks.name: Black Serpent Fang
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Obtain Flaming Mane, then enter the room and pick it up from the table.

Uses:

landmarks.name: Dragon-Shaped Token - Yang
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Use Flaming Mane, enter the house, then pick it up from the table.

Uses:

landmarks.name: White Jade Twins
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Leave Survivors' Courtyard, turn left, and go down the steps. Descend into the underground hole and open the green chest to obtain Quick Hand Zhang's treasure "White Jade Twins".

landmarks.name: Unveiled Statue
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Follow the route in the image below through the house to the high ground on the right. Open the green chest to obtain Quick Hand Zhang's treasure "Unveiled Statue".

landmarks.name: Wedding Candles
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Head west from Well of the Three Puppets and climb the steps to the end. Enter the house and deal with the weaver puppet, then turn left, climb the ladder, and open the door. Pick it up near the room's exit.

landmarks.name: Book × 7
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
From the Puppet Testing Grounds Bell, turn right at the fork first and defeat the enemies to remove the red threads. Enter the house to obtain:

Book: "Thread-Binding Sect - [Puppet Base Ledger] Expansion"

Book: "The Herald - Secret Report on Dusk"

Book: "The Herald - Thread Binding Sect Member's Letter"

Book: "The Herald (Unfinished Scripture of the Lady)"

In the inner room, obtain:

Book: "Thread-Binding Sect - The Sevenfold Medicinal Journal"

Book: "The Herald - Letter from the High Elder"

Book: "The Herald (Letter from the Herald to the High Elder)"

landmarks.name: The Order 5
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Beneath the tree to the left of the dock.

landmarks.name: Thread Binding Sect - Puppet Base Construction Notes
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

From the Puppet Testing Grounds Bell, defeat Mu Xiaokui and open the door. Go to the room with the two cells and head upstairs to obtain the books "Thread Binding Sect - Puppet Base Construction Notes" and "Thread Binding Sect - [Puppet Base Ledger] First Experimental Base".

landmarks.name: Thread Binding Sect - [Puppet Base Ledger] First Experimental Base
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

From the Puppet Testing Grounds Bell, defeat Mu Xiaokui and open the door. Go to the room with the two cells and head upstairs to obtain the books "Thread Binding Sect - Puppet Base Construction Notes" and "Thread Binding Sect - [Puppet Base Ledger] First Experimental Base".

landmarks.name: The Herald - Puppet Mute's Blueprint
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
There is a chest and the book "The Herald - Puppet Mute's Blueprint" to the right of the fork. It reveals that you need a tongue to enter Crimson Manor and investigate the Herald's secret.

landmarks.name: Wulin Tales 9
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
During the quest "A Puppet's Wooden Heart", find Pei's body in the Terraces to obtain the book "Wulin Tales (Songstress Puppet's Letter)".

landmarks.name: Prayers and Vows 1
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Enter the house to the left of the boss arena and pick it up in the room on the left.

landmarks.name: Investigating the Villagers' Belongings 10
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Cross the Covered Bridge and follow the route in image 1 to the house to the east. Obtain the book "Investigating the Villagers' Belongings (Frost Descent)" inside.

landmarks.name: Investigating the Villagers' Belongings 11
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Start in the farmland and use the Dread Axe to break the chain on the north side. Reach the river channel and defeat the enemies. There are many items to collect here, including behind the tree.

landmarks.name: Quick Hand Zhang's Relic List 2
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Speak to Quick Hand Zhang.

landmarks.name: Mystery of the Lady 2
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Head west from Well of the Three Puppets and climb the steps to the end. Enter the house and deal with the weaver puppet, then turn left, climb the ladder, and open the door. Pick it up near the room's exit.

landmarks.name: Investigating the Villagers' Belongings 9
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Start at the Well Bell, climb the stairs, and continue straight until you see the Statue of the Lady of the Veil. Turn left into the house and pick it up on floor 1.

landmarks.name: Wulin Tales 10
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Enter the house beside the Bell to obtain the book "Wulin Tales (Abandoned Puppet's Letter)".

This hints that Dusk's decoy has red eyes, which will be useful in the later fight against Dusk.

landmarks.name: Mystery of the Lady 1
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
A bridge is visible from the barred door. Go to the southern part of the river channel beneath it, where a path leads to the courtyard to the east. Enter the house on the left and pick it up.

landmarks.name: Investigating the Villagers' Belongings 8
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Read the notice beside the well guarded by three puppets to obtain the book "Investigating the Villagers' Belongings (Well Closure Notice)".

landmarks.name: Reflections 12
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
On the table beside the Bell.

landmarks.name: Wulin Tales 8
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Below the Crossroads Bell, enter the house circled in the image below to collect the books "Zuo Shang's Game (Joint Oath Against Enemy)", "Pillars of Kunlun (Joint Operation Plan)", and "Wulin Tales (Wanted: Four Maskwalker Leaders)".

landmarks.name: Zuo Shang's Game 2
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Below the Crossroads Bell, enter the house circled in the image below to collect the books "Zuo Shang's Game (Joint Oath Against Enemy)", "Pillars of Kunlun (Joint Operation Plan)", and "Wulin Tales (Wanted: Four Maskwalker Leaders)".

landmarks.name: Pillars of Kunlun 3
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Below the Crossroads Bell, enter the house circled in the image below to collect the books "Zuo Shang's Game (Joint Oath Against Enemy)", "Pillars of Kunlun (Joint Operation Plan)", and "Wulin Tales (Wanted: Four Maskwalker Leaders)".

landmarks.name: Wulin Tales 5
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Pick it up before the bridge.

landmarks.name: Captive Fate 10
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Use Flaming Mane, enter the house, then pick it up from the table.

landmarks.name: Captive Fate 9
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Use Flaming Mane, enter the house, then look in the second room on the right.

landmarks.name: Captive Fate 1
landmarks.description: How to obtain: On the small path at the entrance to the hidden realm.

landmarks.name: Traversal Talisman
landmarks.description: How to Obtain:

landmarks.name: Weapon Reforge Talisman
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Pick it up beside the Bell.

landmarks.name: Weapon Reforge Talisman
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
From the Bell, enter the house containing the mechanical behemoth. Climb the ladder upstairs to find a chest and items to collect.

landmarks.name: Traversal Talisman
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Beside the barred door.

landmarks.name: Weapon Reforge Talisman
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
On the steps beside the Bell.

landmarks.name: Weapon Reforge Talisman, Phantom Reforge Talisman
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
There are items to pick up behind Quick Hand Zhang, to the left.

landmarks.name: Weapon Reforge Talisman, Traversal Talisman
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

A bridge is visible from the barred door. There are items to collect at the southern end of the river channel.

landmarks.name: Traversal Talisman x1
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
A bridge is visible from the barred door. Go to the river channel beneath it and follow the northern branch to its end to find a Traversal Talisman.

landmarks.name: Traversal Talisman x1
landmarks.description: How to Obtain:

landmarks.name: Remnant Dust × 1021
landmarks.description: Location: Break the crates on the balcony, beside the corpse.

landmarks.name: Buddhist Shrine
landmarks.description: Location: Beside the path up the mountain.

landmarks.name: Remnant Dust
landmarks.description: Location:

landmarks.name: 520 Remnant Dust
landmarks.description: Location:

landmarks.name: 526 Remnant Dust
landmarks.description: Location:

landmarks.name: 1,026 Remnant Dust
landmarks.description: Location:

landmarks.name: Remnant Dust × 2096
landmarks.description: Location:

landmarks.name: 524 Remnant Dust
landmarks.description: Location:

landmarks.name: 1,048 Remnant Dust
landmarks.description: Location:

landmarks.name: The Journey Home
landmarks.description:
Prerequisite:

Speak to the coachman Old Man Gen to accept the quest.

Quest reward:

Quest steps:

1. Continue through Village of Lu, defeat the chapter boss Mu Xiaokui, and open the gate to Pangzhen at the Puppet Testing Grounds.

2. Return to Old Man Gen's Hideout and speak to the coachman Old Man Gen. Tell him that the road to Pangzhen is open.

Choose "Agree to Old Man Gen's request directly" to receive Old Man Gen's Brass Key.

3. After obtaining the Phantom Edge Flaming Mane, go to the Flaming Mane interaction circled in red in image 1. Continue exploring ahead and activate the Old Man Gen's House Bell. Follow the stairs on the left and open the door. Enter the house and interact with the old woman on the bed to obtain the Dusty Old Wooden Comb.

4. Return to Old Man Gen's Hideout on the Village of Lu map and speak to Old Man Gen to complete "The Journey Home".

landmarks.name: Leave None Alive (Conclusion)
landmarks.description:
Prerequisite:

Speak to Old Man Gen to accept the quest.

Quest steps:

Friendly NPCs at the Weeping Creek Valley Outpost, Long Pillar Overlook in Weeping Creek Valley, and the Thieves' Camp in Crimson Forest have been transformed by Sha-Chi. Return to these locations and deal with the enemies.

The quest has two steps:

1. Defeat the monk at the Weeping Creek Valley Outpost to obtain the story item Prayer Beads. Give them to the monk in Survivors' Courtyard.

2. Clear out the thieves at the Thieves' Camp in Crimson Forest to obtain the story item Thief's Manual. Give it to the Wounded Thief in front of Smuggler's Tunnel Entrance.

landmarks.name: A Puppet's Wooden Heart
landmarks.description:
A Puppet's Wooden Heart Quest Quick Walkthrough in Phantom Blade Zero
Speak with the Songstress Puppet and obtain her letter that is to be given to Pei. Pei can be found behind the Temple of Fireflies in the Curvivors' Courtyard, northeast of the Songstress Puppet.
Make your way there to find Pei sitting on some haystacks by a shed. Speak to him and hand him the letter to watch him run away.
Return to the Songstress Puppet, where you find Pei speaking to her. Speak with them to be asked to find Pei's body.
Make your way up north at the Terraces where you can find his body by a campfire. Interact with the body to obtain the Songstress Puppet's Letter.
Return to the Songstress and tell her about Pei's fate. Afterwards, interact with their bodies to obtain the A Puppet's Wooden Heart accessory.

landmarks.description:

Quest steps:

Friendly NPCs at the Weeping Creek Valley Outpost, Long Pillar Overlook in Weeping Creek Valley, and the Thieves' Camp in Crimson Forest have been transformed by Sha-Chi. Return to these locations and deal with the enemies.

The quest has two steps:

1. Defeat the monk at the Weeping Creek Valley Outpost to obtain the story item Prayer Beads. Give them to the monk in Survivors' Courtyard.

2. Clear out the thieves at the Thieves' Camp in Crimson Forest to obtain the story item Thief's Manual. Give it to the Wounded Thief in front of Smuggler's Tunnel Entrance.

Notes:

The area to the left of the Weeping Creek Valley Outpost is now open, too. You can return there to collect the final evidence concerning the Four Fierce Axes.

landmarks.name: Yuzan, No. 3 Musician Puppet
landmarks.description:
From the Beneath the Well Bell, cross the river and fight the boss Yuzan, No. 3 Musician Puppet.

Reward:

Phantom Edge: Heartrend Pipa

Combat tips:

1. Deflect all of her white orbs back at her to deal heavy damage.

2. Be very careful when she summons the large suction orb. Its pull is extremely strong, so jump away as quickly as possible and get as far away as you can.

landmarks.name: Dusk the Puppeteer
landmarks.description:
Prerequisite:

You must collect all six of Firefly's Memory Flowers to find this boss. After collecting them, enter the main house beside the Temple of Blue Fireflies and continue to the mist at the far end. Activate the Broken Puppet Pit Entrance Bell, then jump down beside the fishing puppet to reach the boss arena.

Reward:

Phantom Edge: Puppeteer's Bell

Combat tips:

1. When the boss's health drops below half, a double is summoned. During this phase, no other minions are summoned.

The boss's moves are fairly easy to block or dodge. One of the two has conspicuously red eyes; defeat the red-eyed one first.

2. It is recommended to bring the Kuye Temple Prayer Beads obtained from the earlier boss to summon minions to help you.

landmarks.name: Mu Xiaokui
landmarks.description:
Take the lift up beside the Puppet Testing Grounds Bell, then approach the dock to trigger the story scene and begin the Mu Xiaokui boss fight.

Notes and rewards:

If you have already collected all five Young Mistress red ribbons, Mu Xiaokui gains an additional final phase. Completing it grants the weapon Fiend Saws and the Soul Tempering Material Fist Fragment: Core as additional rewards.

After the battle, you always obtain the story item Puppet No. 44's Eye.

Combat tips:

1. Mu Xiaokui has 2 phases. Collecting all the red ribbons adds a hidden phase in which Jade Dancer and Iron Fiend are summoned to attack you together.

2. The first two phases are fairly easy; fight normally, balancing offense and defense.

3. The two-boss fight in phase 3 is very frustrating. Fortunately, both bosses have fairly little health. Summon-focused Phantom Edges and accessories are recommended.

landmarks.name: Acolyte Yanru
landmarks.description:
Touch the scarecrow with a talisman seal to enter the Discordance challenge.

Reward:

Story item: Yanru's Blazing Mask

Combat tips:

1. A purely ranged boss. The abilities look flashy, but their stats are fairly ordinary. You can return to challenge this boss after obtaining the Flameward accessory in Pangzhen.

2. When the boss flies into the air, homing fireballs are released. Use sprinting and dodging to avoid them. A red-flash attack always follows at the end; repeatedly pressing dodge will generally let you luck into a perfect dodge.

landmarks.name: Remains of Master Bi Hai of Kuye Temple
landmarks.description:
Reward:

Phantom Edge: Kuye Temple Prayer Beads

Combat tips:

Equip the Shieldbreaker Talisman!

1. This boss is a summoner. During the fight, he raises a golden-bell barrier, and his Sha-Chi meter turns into a blue shield bar. The boss does not attack while in this state.

Once all summons have been defeated, the boss emerges and causes an explosion around himself. Dodge it.

2. Alternatively, use the Iron Gauntlets to break the boss's guard directly. You have enough Dark Source on Normal difficulty.

landmarks.name: Remains of Master Bi Yuan of the Tianxuan Sect
landmarks.description:
Reward:

Tianxuan Bronze Sword

Combat tips:

A very straightforward parry-focused boss, with unhurried attacks and no unfair tricks. This is also where the protagonist's stats start keeping pace with the bosses.

landmarks.name: Zhuo Bi the Gatekeeper
landmarks.description:
Reward:

Phantom Edge: Bastion

Combat tips:

A fairly easy boss. Equip the Shieldbreaker Talisman and use the Dread Axe or Iron Gauntlets to break the shield, then land a few polearm hits to perform an execution.

landmarks.name: starting area
landmarks.description: An excellent map: it encourages exploration without being overly complex, and the final boss is fantastic.

landmarks.description: From here on out, players can drop down wherever. This will not result in death but will lead you to a new location.

landmarks.description: Destroy the puppet at the Blackstone Fragment location to remove the threads.

landmarks.description: After finding all 6 Memory Flowers for the purple quest "Secrets at the Heart of the Lake", you can dispel the mist here.

landmarks.name: New Story Events in the First Two Maps
landmarks.description:
Friendly NPCs at the Weeping Creek Valley Outpost, Long Pillar Overlook in Weeping Creek Valley, and the Thieves' Camp in Crimson Forest have been transformed by Sha-Chi.
The area to the left of the Weeping Creek Valley Outpost is now open, too. You can return there to collect the final evidence concerning the Four Fierce Axes.

landmarks.name: Red Ribbon 5
landmarks.description: Activate the Beneath the Well Bell. There is a red ribbon ahead, one of the collectibles required for the collection quest "Young Mistress".

landmarks.name: Red Ribbon 4
landmarks.description: A crane-shaped Bell appears after defeating the boss, with a red ribbon above it. This is one of the collectibles required for the collection quest "Young Mistress".

landmarks.name: Red Ribbon 3
landmarks.description: On the Covered Bridge, use the grappling hook to jump across, then examine the red ribbon.

landmarks.name: Enemy Controlling the Red Threads
landmarks.description: Start in the farmland and use the Dread Axe to break the chain on the north side. Reach the river channel and defeat the enemy to remove the red threads blocking the Covered Bridge.

landmarks.name: Puppet Containing the Weaver's Consciousness
landmarks.description:
Head west from Well of the Three Puppets and climb the steps to the end. Enter the house and complete the Local Tale "A Dream of Motherhood (Weaver Puppet)" to receive the accessory Mother's Talisman.
Related quest:

A Dream of Motherhood

landmarks.name: Red Ribbon 2
landmarks.description: There is a red ribbon on a branch beside the Bell. It is one of the collectibles required for the collection quest "Young Mistress".

landmarks.name: Red Ribbon 1
landmarks.description: Continue ahead from Zhuo Bi's boss arena and interact with the red ribbon on the tree at the end of the bridge to accept the quest.

landmarks.name: After Obtaining the Shield, Return to the First Two Maps to Explore Hidden Areas
landmarks.description: After obtaining the shield, return to the first two maps to explore hidden areas.

landmarks.name: Collect the items before taking the lift back to the Puppet Testing Grounds
landmarks.description: Collect the items before taking the lift back to the Puppet Testing Grounds. The lift will break down, preventing you from returning to the lakeside for a while.

landmarks.name: After opening the door, remember to go back and speak with Young Master Lan and Old Man Gen
landmarks.description: After opening the door, remember to go back and speak with Young Master Lan and Old Man Gen.

landmarks.name: Remember to loot the Smuggler's Treasure Cellar before heading to Pangzhen
landmarks.description: Remember to loot the Smuggler's Treasure Cellar before heading to Pangzhen.

landmarks.name: Polished Broadplate Metal x4
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Go via the large covered bridge, then follow the route shown in Image 1 to the house to the east and collect the treasure chest.
